question: If Intellect Devourer leaves the battlefield before its Devour Intellect ability resolves, do opponents exile any cards from their hands?

expected.shortAnswer: No: opponents won't exile any cards from their hands.
expected.answer: If Intellect Devourer leaves the battlefield before the Devour Intellect ability resolves, opponents won't exile any cards from their hands.
